The '''''Hut''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
Following [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s betrayed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and attempted coup d'etat and [[Battle of Imperial Center|kidnapping]] against [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor Palpatine]] which failed, he and his and his fleet decided to focus their efforts on demolishing loyalist Imperial infrastructure, starting with striping the Empire of its growing technological advantage in starfighter superiority. One of his first targets were the [[TIE/ad starfighter]] production facilities in the [[Omar]] system: ''[[Omar 1]]'', ''[[Omar 2]]'', and ''[[Omar 3]]''. Sending a massive fleet that overwhelmed the local defenses, Zaarin left the loyalist Imperial forces with no other choice but to abandon the facilities and to save the surviving personnel on these stations. The ''Libro'' was one of the many Imperial transports assigned to rescue as many of the surviving crew as possible on ''Omar 1'', and then escape before Zaarin's forces could intercept it.

Loyalist forces sent 3 [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] lead by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] to hold of the forces long enough for the personnel to escape. When Stele arrived, the ''Hut'' was next in line to dock with ''Omar 1'' and load the ship with personnel. Once the transport was full the ship escaped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] as eventually ''Omar 1'' was destroyed.
